summary.text: At a glance: Norsk Hydro ASA is a public limited company (ASA) in Oslo, working in produksjon av aluminium; 395 registered employees and operating revenue NOK 154,000,000 in 2025, up 73% on 2024; website https://www.hydro.com.

What's new (past 12 months, newest first): 2026-11-12 employee count updated: 395; 2026-11-10 latest of 3 news posts on its website: "Hydro and Mercedes-Benz take next step in partnership"; 2026-10-14 board registration changed (chair: Rune Bjerke); 2026-10-14 business address changed; 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 391; 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 400; +8 more.
Norsk Hydro ASA (org. no. 914778271): Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 1905-12-02.

What it does: Primary industry: 24.420 Produksjon av aluminium. Registered purpose: Drive industri, handel og transport, og å nyttig- gjøre energi og råstofforekomster, samt å drive annen virksomhet i forbindelse med disse formål. Virksomheten kan også drives ved deltagelse i eller i samarbeid med andre foretagender.
Business address: Drammensveien 260, 0283 OSLO, Norge (OSLO municipality).
Size: 395 registered employees; latest filed company accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31): operating revenue NOK 154,000,000, annual result NOK 5,880,000,000.
People: CEO (daglig leder): Eivind Kallevik; board chair: Rune Bjerke; 11 other board members; auditor: KPMG AS.
Locations: 11 active sub-units registered (incl. HOLMESTRAND, HUSNES, HØYANGER, NESFLATEN, SUNNDALSØRA).
Status: no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced-dissolution flags registered.
Website: https://www.hydro.com (as registered, and verified on the site).
Company-owned profiles linked from its website: https://facebook.com/norskhydroasa, https://instagram.com/norskhydroasa, https://linkedin.com/company/norsk-hydro.
Hiring: no active job ads on arbeidsplassen.no (NAV) for this company or its sub-units.
Recent registry activity: 2026-11-12 employee count updated: 395; 2026-10-14 business address changed; 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 391 (15 events since 2025).

Latest news on its website: 2026-11-10 "Hydro and Mercedes-Benz take next step in partnership"; 2026-11-04 "Mandatory notification of trade by primary insider"; 2026-11-04 "Ronal joins Hydro initiated Corridor program to strengthen long-term development in the Brazilian Amazon".
Changes: none since the previous check on 2026-11-13.
Unknown or not published: job postings (none active on NAV).
